nodes.title: SG-4.3 · Extract transitions and wire the thin BootScene
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.ts (82 lines) still holds the transitionTo handler inline (reactToPhaser.on('transitionTo') + cameras.main.fadeOut + scene.start) and the TRANSITION_FADE_MS constant. Preload, build and characters are already modules. Desired behaviour: phaser/transitions.ts owns the transition effect and ignores a request made while one is running. BootScene composes all modules and calls every dispose on SHUTDOWN. Expected result: same visuals, BootScene under 200 lines, transition and shutdown tests pass. Why: finishes SG-4.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a transition is running, when transitionTo is emitted again, then the camera fades out only once and scene.start is called once.
- Given BootScene is created, when SHUTDOWN fires, then the transitions dispose runs and later transitionTo events do nothing.
- Given the refactor, when BootScene.ts is counted, then it has fewer than 200 lines and the existing bootSceneTransition* tests pass unchanged.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/transitions.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts
- Out of scope: backend/
- Out of scope: api/client.ts
- Out of scope: new juice or new transition visuals
- Out of scope: SG-4.1 and SG-4.2 modules
- Preserve: 300 ms fade-out then scene.start
- Preserve: unknown or empty sceneId is ignored
- Preserve: playSceneTransition on scene create


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test deleted or skipped
- No source file over 200 lines; game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Zustand store remains the only owner of GameState
- No new features or juice


## Definition of done
- transitions.ts exists and is used by BootScene
- BootScene calls dispose on SHUTDOWN
- tests and typecheck green in game/frontend


## Non-functional requirements
- No per-frame allocation; listeners released on shutdown


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · transitions module fades to a scene and ignores requests while one is running
nodes.body:
Context: the handler in BootScene.create fades the main camera out for 300 ms then starts the scene, and nothing stops a second transitionTo from queuing another fade. Desired: phaser/transitions.ts exports TRANSITION_FADE_MS and createTransitions(scene) returning { dispose }. Expected: one fade per transition, invalid ids ignored, dispose unsubscribes. Why: spec of SG-4.3.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a registered scene id, when transitionTo is emitted, then cameras.main.fadeOut is called once with TRANSITION_FADE_MS and scene.start is called with the id only after FADE_OUT_COMPLETE.
- Given a transition is running, when transitionTo is emitted again, then fadeOut is not called again.
- Given the fade completed, when transitionTo is emitted again, then a new fade starts.
- Given an empty or unregistered sceneId, then nothing happens and later requests still work.
- Given dispose was called, when transitionTo is emitted, then nothing happens.


## Scope
- In scope: new phaser/transitions.ts
- Out of scope: changing fade duration or visuals
- Preserve: Phaser.Cameras.Scene2D.Events.FADE_OUT_COMPLETE usage


## Technical constraints
- Phaser ~3.90.0 APIs only
- File under 200 lines
- Returns a dispose function


## Definition of done
- Module compiles and typechecks


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene composes the modules, disposes every one on SHUTDOWN and stays under 200 lines
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.create holds the inline handler and the unsubscribeTransition field. Desired: BootScene calls createTransitions(this), stores it, and disposes it in SHUTDOWN next to input, preloader, build and characters; it re-exports TRANSITION_FADE_MS so existing imports keep working. Expected: thin shell under 200 lines, behaviour unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given create() ran, when transitionTo is emitted, then the camera fades out as before (existing bootSceneTransition tests pass).
- Given SHUTDOWN fired, then every module dispose, including transitions, was called once and transitionTo is ignored.
- Given BootScene.ts, then it has fewer than 200 lines and imports no engine code from game/frontend.


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene.ts create and SHUTDOWN
- Out of scope: preload, build, characters module internals
- Preserve: export { FALLBACK_KEY } and TRANSITION_FADE_MS exports
- Preserve: sceneReady emit


## Technical constraints
- Phaser ~3.90.0
- Zustand store only owner of GameState
- No source file over 200 lines


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- Inline handler and unsubscribeTransition field removed


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Create phaser/transitions.ts with createTransitions
nodes.body:
Move the handler logic out of BootScene.create into a new module and add a running flag so overlapping requests are ignored. No visual change.

## Acceptance criteria
- createTransitions(scene) subscribes to reactToPhaser transitionTo and returns { dispose }.
- A running flag blocks a second fade until FADE_OUT_COMPLETE; dispose unsubscribes and neutralises a pending completion.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/transitions.ts
- Out of scope: BootScene edits
- Preserve: 300 ms fade, scene.get guard


## Technical constraints
- Phaser ~3.90.0 pinned
- No visual change
- Under 200 lines
- New file: `game/frontend/src/phaser/transitions.ts`


## Definition of done
- transitions.ts typechecks and exports TRANSITION_FADE_MS and createTransitions


## Clarifying questions
- None
nodes.summary: New module owning the transitionTo fade with a running guard and dispose

acceptance_criteria: createTransitions(scene) subscribes to reactToPhaser transitionTo and returns { dispose }.
A running flag blocks a second fade until FADE_OUT_COMPLETE; dispose unsubscribes and neutralises a pending completion.
definition_of_done: transitions.ts typechecks and exports TRANSITION_FADE_MS and createTransitions

steps.action: Create the file importing Phaser, reactToPhaser and type Unsubscribe from './events'. Export const TRANSITION_FADE_MS = 300, interface Transitions { dispose(): void }, and createTransitions(scene: Phaser.Scene): Transitions. Inside keep let running = false and let disposed = false. Subscribe with reactToPhaser.on('transitionTo', ({ sceneId }) => ...): return when disposed, running, !sceneId or !scene.scene.get(sceneId); otherwise set running = true, call scene.cameras.main.once(Phaser.Cameras.Scene2D.Events.FADE_OUT_COMPLETE, () => { running = false; if (!disposed) scene.scene.start(sceneId); }) then scene.cameras.main.fadeOut(TRANSITION_FADE_MS). dispose sets disposed = true and calls the unsubscribe.
steps.expected: npm run typecheck in game/frontend passes with the new module.

steps.expected: Existing imports of TRANSITION_FADE_MS from BootScene still resolve.

steps.action: Replace `private unsubscribeTransition: Unsubscribe | null = null;` with `private transitions: Transitions | null = null;`.

Replace the `this.unsubscribeTransition = reactToPhaser.on(...)` block with `this.transitions = createTransitions(this);`. In the SHUTDOWN callback replace the two unsubscribeTransition lines with `this.transitions?.dispose(); this.transitions = null;`.
steps.expected: BootScene has no inline fade code and is well under 200 lines; typecheck passes.

nodes.summary: Unit tests for fade, deferred start, ignore-while-running, invalid ids, dispose
nodes.description: Tests with a fake Phaser scene (cameras.main.once/fadeOut, scene.get/start spies) and the real reactToPhaser bus.
acceptance_criteria: Fade once and start only after FADE_OUT_COMPLETE.
Second request while running ignored; allowed after completion.
Empty/unknown id ignored; nothing after dispose.

steps.action: Create the test file. vi.mock('phaser', () => ({ default: { Cameras: { Scene2D: { Events: { FADE_OUT_COMPLETE: 'camerafadeoutcomplete' } } } } })). Build a fake scene { cameras: { main: { once: vi.fn(), fadeOut: vi.fn() } }, scene: { get: vi.fn((id) => id === 'library' ? {} : null), start: vi.fn() } }. beforeEach call reactToPhaser.clear(). Add tests: (1) emit transitionTo {sceneId:'library'} -> fadeOut called once with TRANSITION_FADE_MS, start not called; invoke the once callback captured for 'camerafadeoutcomplete' -> start called once with 'library'. (2) emit twice before completion -> fadeOut toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); after calling completion callback and emitting again -> fadeOut called 2 times. (3) emit '' and 'nope' -> fadeOut not called. (4) call dispose() then emit -> fadeOut not called; and dispose before the pending completion callback runs -> start not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserTransitions.test.ts
